## Description
 &#10;&#9;&#9;Gravity Gradiometer uses Gravity Gradiometry as the method for measuring underground density&#10;&#9;&#9;based on local gravitational field anomaly. It builds a picture of subsurface anomalies &#10;&#9;&#9;which can then be used to more accurately image water column density, when locating &#10;&#9;&#9;submerged objects, or determining water depth (bathymetry). It may even target oil, &#10;&#9;&#9;gas and mineral deposits for terrestrial applications. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;Physical scientists use gravimeters to determine the exact size and shape of the earth. &#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravity_gradiometry&#10;&#9;&#9;See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravity_anomaly&#10;&#9;&#9;
